# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **~7-minute sessions signal strong portal engagement** — Despite a 30.4% decline in visitor volume over six months, the average session lasts roughly seven minutes with only a 15% bounce rate, indicating active catalog browsing by the buyers who do visit. [→ §portal]
2. **New Jersey drives nearly 1 in 5 portal visitors** — The top five states (NJ, TX, TN, NC, MS) account for half of all portal traffic over the trailing six months, with New Jersey leading at 19.2%. [→ §portal]
3. **86% of portal traffic arrives directly** — Direct visits dominate the trailing six months, with referral links contributing another 12% — search and advertising together represent under 2% of visitors. [→ §portal]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Investigate the 30.4% traffic decline over the trailing six months — with search contributing only 1.5% of visitors and advertising under 1%, targeted referral or search-optimization efforts could potentially recover lost visitor volume [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §portal]
